description.value: Pappa Leo's Pizza is a locally-owned pizza chain that has been serving the Lower Mainland since 2003, operating seven community-rooted locations including one in Pitt Meadows. The chain is known for scratch-made dough and award-winning pizzas using fresh, high-quality ingredients. A touring cyclist passing through the Fraser Valley corridor could stop for a quick pickup order, with online ordering and contactless delivery available.
